PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS
AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT)ACT, NO. 28 OF 1964 Notice under Section 7

I, hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section (7) of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which are required for a public purpose. Description of the Land/Servitude to be Acquired: The allotments of land indicated in following letters in extent of 1.7472 Hectares depicted in the Preliminary Plan No. P.P.K. 3620 dated 29.12.2018 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the village of Panawatta West in the Atalugam Koralaya in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Yatiyantota in the District of Kegalle in Sabaragamuwa Province:
01. Lot No. 01 Name of land: Not indicated; Extent: 0.0635 Hectare. On the North by: Panawatta; On the East by:
Panawatta Estate, Road and Lot No. 2; On the South by: Lot No. 2, Panawatta Estate, Stream and Lot No. 4; On the West by: Stream and Panawatta Estate.

02. Lot No. 02 Name of land: Not indicated; Extent: 0.4047 Hectare. On the North by: Lot No. 1 and Road; On the East by: Panawatta Estate; On the South by: Panawatta Estate; On the West by: Panawatta Estate, Stream, Lot No. 4 and 1.

03. Lot No. 03 Name of land: Not indicated ; Extent: 0.4352 Hectare. On the North by: Lot No. 4; On the East by: Stream; On the South by: Stream and Panawatta Estate; On the West by: Pradeshiya Sabha Road.
04. Lot No. 04 Name of land: Not indicated ; Extent: 0.0973 Hectare.
On the North by: Lot No. 5, Athukoralaya Watta, Stream and Lot No. 1; On the East by: Stream and Lot No. 3; On the South by: Lot No. 3; On the West by: Lot No. 3, Pradeshiya Sabha Road and Lot No. 5.

PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.

05. Lot No. 05 Name of land: Not indicated ; Extent: 0.7465 Hectare. On the North by: Athukoralaya Watta; On the East and South by: Lot No. 4; On the West by: Lot No. 4, Pradeshiya Sabha Road and Athukoralaya Watta.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/servitude are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing , before me at the Yatiyanthota Divisional Secretariat on 08th of April, 2019 at 10.00 a.m. Further, You are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 01st of April, 2019 the nature

of their interest in the lands the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude the amount of compensation and details of the computation of such amount.
Divisional Secretary, Yatiyanthota. At the Divisional Secretariat, Yatiyanthota. 04-316
